$comment: Quality gates for the qa, spec-build and spec-check skills (node .agents/skills/qa/scripts/gates.mjs fast|full) and the Claude Code hooks in .claude/hooks/. `full` runs the recipes of `just ci` (the justfile is what CI runs) without needing `just`; clippy-features needs cargo-hack. `cargo deny check`, the Windows / macOS test jobs and the release builds run in CI only. On Linux the system libraries come first: ./scripts/install-system-deps.sh. `stop` runs in the Claude Code Stop hook after every turn that changed code and must take seconds (`{cargo-packages}` = `-p` for each changed crate, minus `excludePackages`); `fast` runs before every commit (Claude Code commit gate) and in spec-build after each block; both are filtered by `paths` (prefixes of changed repository paths). `needs` lists the ids a gate waits for; gates without needs between them run in parallel. Optional per gate: `fix`, `note`. `#[expect(.., reason = ..)]` is not in `suppressions`: it is how this project silences a lint (workspace lint `allow_attributes_without_reason`).

full.name: clippy per feature
full.command: cargo hack clippy --workspace --each-feature --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
full.note: Needs cargo-hack (`cargo install cargo-hack`). Feature combinations break in ways the default build does not.

full.name: cargo test with features
full.command: cargo test --workspace --all-features && cargo test -p amigo_core --features async_tasks && cargo test -p amigo_core --features system_graph && cargo test -p amigo_engine --features api

full.name: agent skills in sync
full.note: Shared skills are edited in amigo-labs/skills and synced with `node .agents/sync.mjs`; this repository's own skills are edited in .agents/skills, then `node .agents/sync.mjs --mirror`.
